title: Maps of Land and Water
seo_title: Grade 2 Maps of Land and Water Worksheets: Landforms and Bodies of Water
standard_text: Develop a model to represent the shapes and kinds of land and bodies of water in an area.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on maps of land and water (NGSS 2-ESS2-2): mountains, hills, islands, lakes, rivers and oceans, and reading a simple map. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: A map shows land and water.
key_sub: Blue is water. Use the key to find mountains, lakes and rivers.
body_html:
How to think about it

A map is a model of land and water.

  • Blue = water: ocean, lake, river.
  • Land: mountain, hill, island, beach.
  • Use the key to read the map.
Example

On the map, what is at 3?

Water with land all around.

Answer: a lake

Example

Is an island land or water?

It has water around it.

Answer: land

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a lake and an ocean are the same. Oceans are huge and salty.
  • Thinking an island is water. It is land.
  • Thinking a hill and a mountain are the same. Mountains are taller.

faq.a: Mountains, hills, plains, valleys, islands and beaches.
Oceans, lakes, rivers and ponds. Oceans are salty; most lakes and rivers are fresh water.
